scope: Research checker rules; no production UI or simulator behavior changed.

shotgunHipfire.status: Source-backed candidate with verified screenshot matches; native input binding unverified

burstControlPreview.rule: For burst_training, burst_mode and grtbc_burst_mode, calculate Control with the non-burst recoil build, as already done for Precision.
burstControlPreview.evidence: Original KV9 Burst Training screenshot shows Control 60, recoil amount 0.5, variation 50, and no Control delta. The report records the same non-burst preview behavior for all eight burst entries.
burstControlPreview.status: Observed menu-preview behavior; does not change firing simulation

compactHandstopMobility.rule: Add 4 when the resolved grip is cmpct_handstop.
compactHandstopMobility.description: Enables weapon to be fired while sprinting.
compactHandstopMobility.status: Source boolean, delegate coefficient, description and observed +4 agree; native hash name is not independently decoded

hipfireFractionGate.rule: Multiply by sqrt(1.2) when resolved hip spread increase per shot differs from the base value.
hipfireFractionGate.inputCandidate: IncreasePerShotFraction = resolved hip inc / base hip inc
hipfireFractionGate.branchEvidence: Named input offset 16; code offset 32 compares it with constant 1 through unresolved hash c07cd1f5; offset 68 selects constants 1.2 and 1. Comparator direction/semantics remain inferred.
hipfireFractionGate.status: Inferred rule supported by all audited light changes and one increased-inc selector. Only VSSM Folding Stock differs from the old attachment-name gate across the audit; independent generalization is limited.

vssmControl.source: data/weapons.json provenance documents 1.4.3.0 recoil amount 0.6787 -> 0.6834 and variation 45 -> 45.4.
vssmControl.conclusion: The prior exported inputs round to the historical reading. Keep current source data; do not alter Control to fit these three old captures.
